title: Vintage Le Creuset Cast Iron Skillet / Frying Pan – Flame Red – Wooden Handle – Made in France
description:
Beautiful vintage Le Creuset cast iron skillet in the iconic Flame Red / Volcanique enamel finish, featuring its original wooden handle and black enamel cooking surface. A timeless French kitchen classic, highly appreciated by collectors and cooking enthusiasts alike.
This pan combines the exceptional heat retention of cast iron with the elegant vintage Le Creuset design. Perfect for searing, frying, roasting, or everyday cooking. The wooden handle gives it an authentic mid-century French cookware look.
The skillet is in very good vintage condition overall. The cooking surface is clean and well preserved with light signs of normal use. The exterior enamel remains glossy and vibrant, and the wooden handle has a beautiful aged patina consistent with vintage cookware.
